###  [ VENCEDORES APURADOS DO CONCURSO INTERNACIONAL DE ESTUDANTES DE ARQUITETURA DA SAINT-GOBAIN ](https://www.imosa.pt/2023/10/11/vencedores-apurados-do-concurso-internacional-de-estudantes-de-arquitetura-da-saint-gobain/)
Alunos da Coreia do Sul vencem a competição internacional. O segundo prémio foi entregue a Portugal.  
Já são conhecidos os vencedores da 18ª edição do “International Saint-Gobain Architecture Student Contest”. O 1º prémio foi entregue a alunos da Coreia do Sul, da Korea University, e o 2º prémio a estudantes de Portugal, da Faculdade de Arquitetura da Universidade do Porto. O anúncio decorreu numa cerimónia privada, no Pátio da Gale, em Lisboa, e contou com a presença do CEO da Saint-Gobain, Benoit Bazin, o CEO da Saint-Gobain em Portugal, Jose Martos, o Presidente da Câmara Municipal de Lisboa, Carlos Moedas, e estudantes de arquitetura de 30 países.

###  [ Saint-Gobain, Global Top Employer pelo 7º ano consecutivo ](https://www.imosa.pt/2023/10/11/saint-gobain-global-top-employer-pelo-7o-ano-consecutivo/)
Somos Top Employer pelo sétimo ano consecutivo!
Saint-Gobain recebeu a certificação ‘Top Employer Global’ do Top Employers Institute, com base numa auditoria que abrange mais de 400 parâmetros de condições de trabalho e avalia os processos de RH e de desenvolvimento de carreira. O nosso Grupo está entre as 11 empresas a nível mundial que receberam este prémio este ano.
Nesta ocasião, fomos distinguidos por todos os aspectos que contribuem para criar um sentimento de pertença dentro da organização, ou seja, os nossos valores, ética e integridade. Foram também avaliados os bons resultados em termos de estratégia da empresa, liderança e política de recrutamento.
A certificação Top Employer Global 2022 foi atribuída à Saint-Gobain por 38 países já certificados, mais dois do que em 2021, com o Egito e o Vietname incluídos pela primeira vez: Argentina, Austrália, Áustria, Bélgica, Brasil, Canadá, Chile, China, Colômbia, República Checa, Dinamarca, Egito, Estónia, Finlândia, França, Alemanha, Índia, Indonésia, Irlanda, Itália, Japão, Malásia, México, Países Baixos, Polónia, Portugal, Roménia, Arábia Saudita, Coreia do Sul, Espanha, Suécia, Tailândia, Turquia, Emirados Árabes Unidos, Reino Unido, Estados Unidos e Estados Unidos.
Parabéns a todos!

# About us 
##### Leader in mineral production, IMOSA belongs to the "Natural Resources" Business Unit of the French multinational **Saint-Gobain.**  
Present in more than 68 countries, with 180,000 employees and more than 800 manufacturing sites, **Saint-Gobain** is **one of the 100 largest industrial and innovative groups in the world** and, with 350 years of history, **is the leading company in lightweight and sustainable construction.**  
  
In the Business Unit, we have **5 mining operations: three gypsum mines in** : Almeria, a potassium feldspar and silica sand mine in Segovia and a silica sand mine in Portugal.  

## Who we are

##### The production process is designed to guarantee the best product for our customers in the different markets, ensuring quality, homogeneity and the physical-chemical characteristics requested by the customer.  
  
The reserves and the annual production capacity, which exceeds 500.000 tons per year, allow us to be a reliable partner for the future for our customers.

IMOSA has a laboratory with state-of-the-art equipment in its centre. in Guia Pombal (Portugal)
In our [Quality Policy](https://www.imosa.pt/en/politica-da-qualidade-en/), the Laboratory’s main mission is to validate the quality of the product at all stages of the production process in order to control the key parameters.
Our Laboratory prepares, tests and certifies that the characteristics of the final product comply with the customer’s requirements on the basis of the load booklet.
To this end, all the necessary controls (chemistry, granulometry, etc.) are carried out on a daily basis in accordance with [ISO 9001](https://www.imosa.pt/en/iso-9001-en/)– [ISO 14001-](https://www.imosa.pt/en/iso-14001-en/) [ISO 45001. ](https://www.imosa.pt/en/iso-45001-en/)certifications.

The pillar of American pickup trucks, the Ford F-150 has evolved from a rudimentary work truck to a polished and capable commuter through its generations. A part of Ford’s best-selling F-Series, the F-150 consistently tops the full-size pickup sales list. The F-150 lineup is diverse. This half-ton truck is available with a multitude of powertrains and option-rich trim levels. Whether commuting to work during the week or hauling the camper on the weekend, the Ford F-150 delivers the durability and comfort Ford fans expect. A F-150 with a 3.0 liter turbo-diesel engine debuted in 2018 but was retired after the 2021 model year. 2021 saw the introduction of new features to aid in the calculation and measurement of your max payload and trailer tongue weight of the connected trailer, features that may be high on your list if your hauling or towing regularly. 2021 is also the same year the F150 won the North American Truck of the Year award. The F150 is available in rear-wheel drive or [four-wheel-drive (4x4)](https://www.autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/awd-4wd/ford/f150). Some of the popular F-150 trims include the [F-150 King Ranch](https://www.autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/ford/f150/king-ranch), [F-150 Lariat](https://www.autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/ford/f150/lariat), [F-150 Platinum](https://www.autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/ford/f150/platinum), [F-150 Raptor](https://www.autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/ford/f150/raptor), [F-150 STX](https://www.autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/ford/f150/stx), [F-150 Tremor](https://www.autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/ford/f150/tremor), [F-150 XL](https://www.autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/ford/f150/xl) and [F-150 XLT](https://www.autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/ford/f150/xlt). 
**Is buying a used Ford F-150 worth it?**
If you're looking to save some money, opting for a used F-150 instead of a new one is a great choice. These trucks are durable and offer everything most pickup buyers need. However, it's best to steer clear of models manufactured between 1997 and 2003. 
**Is there an Ford F-150 shortage?**
There has been a shortage of F-150s hitting the market due to supply chain issues with certain manufacturing parts necessary for each truck. This delay is causing production of the F-150 to be rolled back.
